introduction: 3SquaresVT is Vermont’s SNAP food-assistance program. DCF reviews household eligibility and provides benefits for approved cases.
description: 3SquaresVT is Vermont’s SNAP food-assistance program. DCF reviews household eligibility and provides benefits for approved cases.

sections.who: Income and household circumstances affect eligibility. Households with an older or disabled member may qualify under different rules; ask DCF rather than relying on an old table.
sections.get: Monthly help buys eligible food. Most households use EBT; the state lists a cash-deposit route for households consisting entirely of people age 65 or older or receiving SSI.
sections.docs:
• Household identity information.
  • Income and relevant expense evidence.
  • Requested status and other verification.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use the myBenefits link on 3SquaresVT or request Form 202 at 800-479-6151.

  2. Submit signed records

    Return paper forms by the listed mail, district-office or document-upload route.

  3. Complete follow-up

    Respond to the interview and verification requests, explaining urgent food needs.
sections.after: Read the decision and case-specific reporting instructions. Older or disabled households can ask about simplified intake.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DCF 3SquaresVT. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does everyone use an EBT card?
Some all-older or SSI households receive cash deposits under state rules.
What if I am unsure about income eligibility?
Apply or call the Benefits Service Center for assessment.
